publishedDescription: An interactive 3D DC circuit simulation laboratory and dual-workbench environment for verifying Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL) and Voltage Law (KVL). Features synchronized 2D-to-3D circuit building, collision-based polarity probing to resolve sign convention confusion, real-time dynamic nodal solving, an AI 2D image-to-3D circuit generator, and an automated digital lab notebook.
